subject: Evidence pack sprint plan for UK IDTA + onshore routing options
messages:
From: Sarah Langston <sarah.langston@medicore.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Cc: dataprotection@medicore.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Evidence pack & routing options for UK IDTA

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the overview last week. We're moving into a tight compliance window for our UK rollout and need a consolidated evidence pack to support the UK IDTA (and the accompanying TIA/DTIA scoping). Specifically we need:

- A completed evidence checklist for the UK IDTA (controls mapping + attestations)
- Subprocessor inventory with country of processing and subprocessors' SCC/UK addendum status
- A short memo on routing options (onshore vs. offshore processing, timing implications)

Can your team deliver a draft evidence pack and a recommended routing approach by the end of next week? If not, please propose a sprint timeline. We may need to involve procurement for contract redlines afterwards.

Attachments we expect: uk-idta-evidence-checklist.xlsx, subprocessor inventory export, routing-options summary PDF.

Thanks,
Sarah
Data Privacy Lead — MediCore Health

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Langston <sarah.langston@medicore.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 12:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence pack & routing options for UK IDTA

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can put together a draft evidence pack and routing recommendation. Proposed approach:

1) Sprint split across three workstreams (owners below) — 4 business days for first draft.
   - Evidence checklist & control attestations (owner: Neha)
   - Subprocessor export + status flags (owner: Vivek)
   - Routing options memo (owner: Ava / infra lead)

2) Deliverables by end of day Friday (2026-10-15) for MediCore review: checklist XLSX, subprocessor CSV, 2-page routing-options PDF.

3) We'll include a short appendix mapping each required UK IDTA section to our artifact (policy, config, audit log extracts). If procurement needs contract language updates, we can flag specific clauses for redline.

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync Tuesday morning (2026-10-13) to walk through the draft? If that works, I'll invite the infra lead and our contracts rep.

Ava Chen
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, sarah.langston@medicore.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence pack & routing options for UK IDTA

Thanks — quick inventory note from the subprocessor side: attached is the current export (subprocessor-inventory.csv). It includes columns for: vendor name, primary service, processing countries, contract date, SCCs applied (EU), UK addendum applied (Y/N), data types processed, and last security assessment date.

High level:
- ~12 subprocessors touching EU/UK data; 3 are already on UK addendum (tokenization, logging pipeline, hosting); 2 are pending legal review and will require addendum signatures (one is an analytics vendor, one for transcription).
- For onshore routing options: short-term we can route sessions to our UK-dedicated pool (limited capacity) — this requires a minor configuration change and pop-up notice to ops. Mid-term we recommend a scheduled capacity migration + contract confirmation from the hosting subprocessor.

I'll attach the CSV and a short snapshot of outstanding vendor items to the draft pack.

Attachments: subprocessor-inventory.csv (stub)

— Vivek
Senior Infrastructure Security Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.langston@medicore.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence pack & routing options for UK IDTA

Team —

I've started mapping controls to the UK IDTA sections. Quick callouts / risks to flag in the pack:

- Audit logs: we can export token-level retention statements but need to confirm retention window for UK-hosted pools (ops).
- Data minimization: we have a small number of product flows where embeddings are retained for QoS; I'll call out the exact flows and mitigation.
- Pending Subprocessors: Vivek's list highlights two vendors without signed UK addenda; this is the highest gating item for an executed IDTA.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 2026-10-13: 30m sync to confirm scope and ask list (I'll produce the checklist template by EOD Mon).
- Wed 2026-10-14: Internal draft complete (control mappings + vendor statuses).
- Fri 2026-10-15: Consolidated pack to MediCore.

I'll include short export snippets (audit-log query examples) and a recommended wording paragraph for procurement to use in addendum negotiations.

Neha Kapoor
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Langston <sarah.langston@medicore.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence pack & routing options for UK IDTA

Ava / team —

Thanks for the clear plan. Tuesday 2026-10-13 09:30 UK time works for our side — please send the calendar invite. Primary objective for the sync: confirm the two gating subprocessors and agree remediation or compensating controls so we can scope the final IDTA endorsement.

Also, please include any short-term onshore routing cost estimate (even a high-level delta) in the Friday deliverable — that'll help our procurement and ops teams make a go/no-go call.

Looking forward to the draft.

Best,
Sarah
Data Privacy Lead — MediCore Health
